info.title: Versioned campaign API
info.description: Disabled by default. Public responses never include wallet state. All responses are no-store; private responses are private, no-store. Lists may stop below limit to retain the 1 MiB response bound; follow nextCursor. Publication and personal versions are canonical decimal strings.

schema.description: Opaque session-bound stream position. Omit to anchor, then read the authoritative REST snapshot before continuing.

200.description: Invalidation hints only. resetRequired anchors a new cursor; read the authoritative REST snapshot before continuing. HTTP reads never acknowledge durable business consumption.

400.description: Invalid closed input, query, or version.

401.description: Missing, expired, or invalid SIWE credential.

404.description: No visible resource or command for this principal.

503.description: Unavailable or invalid dependency response. After an uncertain write, reconcile the same command key.

schema.description: Comma-separated response variants the client decodes. legacyBaselineV1 returns imported campaigns as contentState legacyBaseline with a read-only baseline object; contentCapabilitiesV1 marks a client that checks media and trade targets itself, and only such a client receives content with media or a trade entry as ready. Unknown tokens are ignored.
